qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Architectural and structural engineering specification moat in concrete admixtures, Sikaflex sealants, and roofing membranes where chemical cost is <1-2% of project capex but product failure causes catastrophic damage (30x cost). Demonstrated pricing power by expanding material margin from 53.6% (2023) to 54.9% (2025) through retained input cost deflation.
qualitative.note: Specification-driven moat in concrete admixtures and construction sealants where chemical cost is <2% of build cost but failure risk is 30x. Material margins expanded to ~55% via retained input deflation; rapid post-MBCC deleveraging with >100% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: organic infra/repair volume 3.5% + pricing power net of CHF FX drag 0.5% + MBCC synergies and deleveraging 1.5% + selective bolt-on M&A 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 14.0% with operating/tangible ROIC exceeding 50%. Material margin expanded from 53.6% in 2023 to 54.9% in 2025. MBCC integration captured CHF 182M+ in cumulative synergies, elevating MBCC EBITDA margins from 15% to >20%. FY2025 operating FCF reached CHF 1.35B (12.1% of sales), reducing net debt to CHF 3.0B with interest coverage of ~9.6x.
